I have everything. Here's the recovered research.

## 1. Historical branches and flattened (squash) merges

The finding comes from a background subagent, **"Map historical fortress branches"** (agent `a4c148eec2be35696`), whose full report is the tool result at **line 1162** of the live transcript. Its headline claim, verbatim:

> All twelve branches are relics of the Sun-era Mercurial/SVN repository, carried over by the 2016 GitHub conversion. A key pattern: every branch that was "finished" ends in an **empty hg close-branch commit** (David Chase's 2012-01-20 "closing X, tired of it" sweep), and the 2008-era research branches were re-landed on trunk via **svn-merge commits that squash the branch history** — so the branch heads are the *only* record of the fine-grained, per-author development steps, even where the final content is fully in trunk.

The twelve branches on `origin` (palimondo/fortress), with tips, unique-commit counts and merge-bases against `a874948` (2012 trunk head):

| Branch | Tip (sha, date) | Unique authors | Not in main | Theme |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `John` | c111201cb, 2011-12-07 | — (tip by Jean-Baptiste Tristan) | **0** | stale pointer into trunk |
| `john` | abc8f4807, 2012-01-27 | Tristan King | 1 (empty "Starting 'john' branch" marker) | hg branch-open marker only |
| `ange_michael` | 259a02d3a, 2012-01-20 | angelee, mspiegel | 35 (34 real) | bytecode top-level env generation, Jun 2008 |
| `bird_count` | 074f85872, 2012-05-25 | — (tip by David Chase) | **0** | stale pointer (Birds demo merged) |
| `hygiene` | f506b7d8b, 2012-01-20 | jon | 6 (5 real) | macro hygiene / alpha-renaming, Sep 2008 |
| `node-interface` | 6908e4fe2, 2012-01-20 | jon | 4 (3 real) | astgen syntax-abstraction AST nodes, Feb–Mar 2009 — **never landed** |
| `perftesting` | dbcdf92aa, 2012-01-20 | mspiegel | 13 (12 real) | perf monitor + JFreeChart, Aug 2008; **orphan root, no merge-base at all** |
| `syntax` | e2c818a34, 2012-01-20 | jon, ryanc | 39 (38 real) | syntax abstraction round 1 |
| `syntax2` | 63135681e, 2012-01-20 | jon, ryanc | 29 (28 real) | round 2: template parser, 2-stage expansion |
| `syntax3` | 7159d9f7f, 2012-01-20 | jon, ryanc | 21 (20 real) | round 3: `=>` transformers, case macros |
| `syntax4` | 9571c665d, 2012-01-20 | jon | 10 (9 real) | round 4: ellipses (`...`) in templates |
| `works` | 0f5f3f3d2, 2012-01-25 | David Chase | 3 (2 merges + 1 empty) | Jan 2012 compiler-merge staging; tree byte-identical to main's a2b230d0b |

Merge-bases recorded: john = 4b0f942fb; ange_michael = cb83d6fc0 (2008-06-05); hygiene = 2f59dbebd (2008-09-19); node-interface = f1b358d34 (2009-02-22); perftesting = **none** (disconnected orphan root ad808cfa6, 2008-08-05); syntax = 3eab1e730; syntax2 = fca589bbb; syntax3 = 1fbf3dcd6; syntax4 = 2f5a95733; works = 22c12feb7.

The specific squashing merge commits identified:

- `ange_michael` → **c15629abf** (mspiegel, 2008-06-18) *"Merging [compiler] branch r2001 into the main trunk"* — squash-landed `TopLevelEnvGenerator.java` (ASM bytecode env per component); code lives on as `compiler/environments/TopLevelEnvGen.java`. "The branch preserves the only per-commit record of who wrote what."
- `hygiene` → **fd30f0b14** (jon, 2008-09-22) *"[merge] svn merge -r2850:HEAD .../branches/hygiene"*; `SyntaxEnvironment.java` is in main today, the five dev commits only on the branch.
- `syntax`/2/3/4 → **4295ddf2f** (r1752:1883, Jun 12), **99ae14ddc** (Jul 31), **cbae53bb6** (Aug 6), **f2dce1624** (Aug 8): "Each was svn-merged into trunk immediately after its last commit … The squash merges mean these ~95 fine-grained commits, including all of Culpepper's individual authorship, exist **only** on these branches."
- `perftesting`: orphan root, *"includes only the source files until the libraries can be OKed by the lawyers"* (the JFreeChart jars were the legal problem); trunk got only the initial two files (42affb1fd, 2008-07-31); `ChartWriter.java` and the rest **never reached trunk**.
- `node-interface`: `astgen/SyntaxAbstractionCreator.java` (154 lines) + `astgen/README-interface` exist nowhere in main's history — genuinely unmerged work.

Verdict given to the user (line 1168): "**Nothing should be merged into `main`**"; at most delete `John` and `bird_count` (zero unique commits), preferably tag `archive/*` first, "since the branch *names* are themselves historical metadata (they record which hg named branches existed at Oracle)". The survey agent also noted the working clone was shallow (74 commits) and it ran `git fetch --unshallow` to get the full **5,397-commit** history.

## 2. Does this explain the ~146 parentless roots? — No; that was a separate, later finding

The two were investigated separately, and **the branch/clone hypothesis was never the explanation offered**. The root-commit analysis (transcript ~lines 7513–7572, reported at line 7572):

> The repository has **147 root commits**: one is the true 2007-01-04 root, and **146 are ordinary 2011–2012 commits whose parent links were severed** by the hg→git conversion behind the GitHub mirror — all from the java.net Mercurial era (80 from 2011, 66 from 2012), e.g. `5a68404fd` "Added odd random longs to MagicNumbers" (Chase, 2012-07-19) is a parentless full-tree snapshot. The first-parent chain from HEAD is only **65 commits deep** before it dead-ends at that phantom root. The pre-2011 SVN-era history is still *reachable* (through old merge commits' side-links, which is why `--full-history` finds 1,335 commits on the interpreter), but any default walk from HEAD hits a seam first.

Hard measurements taken: `git rev-list --max-parents=0 HEAD | wc -l` → **147**; year distribution 1×2007, 80×2011, 66×2012; `git rev-list --count HEAD` → 5456; first-parent chain → 65, ending `575fe6442` → `5a68404fd`. Sample roots: ef7b2bff5 (Tristan King, 2012-06-25, "Bug fix in BirdCount"), 0d00963c6 (changhee, 2012-06-22), a9c625b1e (Chase, 2012-06-19), 81d727ad8, 06efe01c3, 30ca1d8c7, abd3b8eda.

So: the roots are attributed to a **lossy hg→git conversion** (mainline commits turned into full-tree snapshots), **not** to per-developer clones or side branches being imported as disconnected segments. The only branch-related orphan found is `perftesting` (its own orphan root ad808cfa6, 2008-08-05), and that one is *not* among the 146 (it's not reachable from HEAD). No transcript evidence exists for "kitty", "per-developer clone", or named-branch imports as the cause — those terms return nothing relevant. The mechanism of the conversion itself was never determined; the only clue found (line 7033) is that Christine Flood's 2011–12 commits carry `chmfy@users.noreply.github.com`, an address format that only existed from 2013, meaning "whoever converted the java.net Mercurial repo to the GitHub mirror mapped her to a real GitHub account."

The session also noted this is fixable in principle: "Actually fixing that would be a separate archaeology project: healing the 146 seams (finding each phantom root's true parent among the reachable segments and rewriting with `git filter-repo`/`git replace`). Probably doable — the segments are all present — but it's real surgery on the historical artifact and a decision for another day."

## 3. Implications for authorship counts, `git log`, `git blame`

- **Blame is genuinely broken, pre-existing (not caused by the 2026 porcupine graft)**: tested on `Evaluator.java` — all **1,551 lines** blame to `^5a68404fd` (David Chase, 2012-07-19), a commit he barely touched. "This was true *before* our graft and would be true in porcupine-free history too."
- **`git log -- <dir>` is useless**: "at each merge, git's history simplification follows a parent whose tree is identical for that path — and a full-tree snapshot root is always sitting nearby looking identical, so the walk terminates there. Hence 3 commits instead of 1,335."
- **Count noise**: "those 146 snapshot roots each 'introduce' every path, so the `--full-history` per-path counts in the authorship map carry up to ~146 spurious credits spread across 2011–12 committers. Small at the scale of the numbers (Ryu 424, etc.)."
- **Branch-side implication for authorship**: because the 2008 research branches were squash-merged, per-commit authorship for Ryan Culpepper (`ryanc`, 23 commits in the map), Jon Rafkind, Angelina Lee and Michael Spiegel on that work survives **only on the branch heads** — deleting those branches would destroy authorship data that trunk does not carry.
- The graft was exonerated: `8fe1daa8f` is a single-parent commit modifying only **13 pre-existing files** and adding 1,493 (1,087 still in HEAD, 406 since deleted).

## 4. Where the research lives now

- **Committed, but only as a two-line summary** — `/home/user/fortress/explorations/repo-internals.md`, section "Git archaeology techniques" (lines ~225–241): the parallel-root note about `5a68404`/`575fe64`, and: *"The twelve pre-2016 branches are hg named-branch relics; the 2008 research branches were squash-merged into trunk, so fine-grained authorship exists only on the branch heads. Full survey with per-branch verdicts: see the session notes / ask before deleting anything."* Plus "hg conversion quirks: empty 'Starting/Closing branch X' marker commits; `.hgignore` still in tree; David Chase's 2012-01-20 branch-closing sweep."
- **`/home/user/fortress/research/authorship.md`** (lines 14–24, commit `381355769`, "authorship: correct the caveat…") carries the corrected 146-severed-links caveat and the spurious-credit note. No branch section.
- **The full branch survey is NOT committed anywhere in the repo** — the offer "I can drop it into `research/extracts/` or `explorations/` as a committed note if you want it preserved" was made at line 1168 and never taken up (`research/extracts/` holds only `SteeleJuliaCon2016-extract.md` and `fortress-websites-wayback.md`).
- Raw sources: live transcript line **1162** (full report) and **1168** (user-facing summary); the root-commit analysis at lines **7497–7572**. The subagent's own transcript is archived on the orphan `transcripts` branch (commit `9cd319411`) at `projects/-home-user-fortress/bdff267d-67dc-5bb9-b970-8c3dfaa634b6/subagents/agent-a4c148eec2be35696.jsonl` (+ `.meta.json`) — but that archive predates the root-commit analysis (committed 2026-08-19; the 147-roots work is 2026-08-21), so only the branch half is in it.
